rawContent: Exactly! Don’t tell me peaceful protests work when it comes to police brutality! Does #colinkapernick ring a bell? George is not an isolated incident, or any of the victims that pile up, we just have phones. Wake up! #BlackLivesMatter #TrumpResignNow

#JUNETEENTH2020 Happy Juneteenth, beautiful black people everywhere!! This should be A REAL NATIONAL HOLIDAY celebrating freedom for all. We've got a long way to go but let's ALL keep fighting the good fight.  Thank you, Kenya for educating me! @funnyblackdude #BlackLivesMatter
